text: player
Stall Owner
Here's the Super Special Shine Summer Smasher fried noodles you ordered!
Thanks, so this is the fried noodles that people are raving about in the amusement park.

I receive the piping hot noodles. Before I have the chance to take a bite, I sense someone staring at me from behind my back, so I turn around and scan the surroundings carefully, ultimately spotting two heads poking out from behind a wall.
Ichihime, Lin Lang... What are you doing?
Ichihime
Observing your reaction to see if the noodles are tasty or not, nyaa.
Lin Lang
{var:player_nickname}, I'm observing your reaction to see if the food in your hand is poisoned or not.
Am I a lab rat to you?
Ichihime and Lin Lang walk up to me hand in hand and peek at the piping hot noodles in my hand.
It's the Super Smasher Flashbang fried noodles, nyaa!
The Super Invincible Thunderclap Summer-- Argh!!! I-I bit my tongue...
I feel bad for you two since neither of you can remember its name. It's called...
Super Summer Special Flashbang Crusher fried noodles
Super Special Shine Summer Smasher fried noodles
Super Special Summer Limited Crusher fried noodles
Super Special Shine Summer Smasher fried noodles!
Nyaa, nyaa! Master, you're so amazing! You can actually say the full name of this S-Super...
Super Special...
...It's okay. Its name isn't important at all. What's important is whether it tastes good, right?
Will you give me some to eat then, nyaa?
{var:player_nickname}, can I have two portions?
There's no way I can keep these noodles to myself now that they are staring at me so fervently. What should I do?
The more the merrier!
I have to teach them that they won't always get their way!
Although the portion of these noodles is quite large, I decide to buy a few more portions after looking at the two people in front of me.
Okay then. Wait here for me. Can I please have three portions of the special...
Stare--
...Please give me three portions of the Super Special Shine Summer Smasher fried noodles... I-I almost ran out of breath.
Very smashing! It won't be long!
{var:player_nickname}, make it five portions!
Hmm? I thought you said you wanted two...
Master, I want five portions too... No, make it ten, nyaa!
I hope you can be considerate of the account balance of the person paying...

Today's lesson is that it's necessary to be heartless when the situation calls for it. Just as I'm looking at my phone and sighing about losing all my savings, I catch a glimpse of a familiar-looking purple dress from the corner of my eye.
Miki Nikaidou
Oh, it's you, Miki. How will you help me?
Miki Nikaidou's smile gives me a bad feeling...
I just took a look at the food court and found lots of delicious snacks.
If you don't mind, you can all go and try them out. It'll be my treat, hehe.
No, you're already sensible Jyanshis who can go to a dojo all alone to play mahjong. You need to learn to make money to buy your own food.
Hmm... stubborn humans are so much trouble. I have no choice-- Rargh!
Huh?!
Lin Lang opens her mouth to bite my hand, revealing her sharp teeth. Fortunately, I manage to dodge fast enough, or else I'll have more to deal with than teeth marks given the strength of her bite.
Don't reveal such dangerous things in public!!!
How dare you cheat, nyaa! In that case, I won't hold back either, nyaa!
Why are you also... Snap out of it, Ichihime! You're not a tiger!
Nyaaaaaa!
You're forcing me to use my special skill! Super suction--!
I scoop the noodles into my mouth frantically as I dodge their pursuit. Suddenly, I hear a familiar laugh.
Hehe... things sure are lively here.
Miki? You're here at just the right time. They've gotten so hungry that they want to steal my food. Help me!
There's no way I can stop them, but I do have an idea to divert their attention.
Please go ahead, my trusted adviser!
Upon hearing Miki Nikaidou's words, Ichihime and Lin Lang both stop at the same time.

Ichihime and I both have firsthand experience of how terrifying Miki Nikaidou's cooking can be. That's why we definitely need to be careful when assessing whether the "delicious snacks" she mentioned are actually delicious... or edible.
Is it really delicious? I want to have some!

The naive young dragon, unaware of the dangers of the world, wipes the saliva from the corner of her mouth, then she grabs my hand excitedly and starts following Miki Nikaidou. I pull my hand desperately to try to escape her grip, but her hand doesn't budge at all. My plan to secretly sneak away is defeated by Lin Lang's monstrous strength.
W-Wait! I'm full. Lin Lang, you can go with Miki.
I look at my left hand, which Lin Lang is holding firmly, and silently reach out my right hand to grab the back of Ichihime's collar as she tries to run away.
Nyaa! I don't need to become an adult. Master, let go of me now, nyaa!
Ichihime, aren't I the world's best master to you?
Nyaa! Nyaa... yes.
Ichihime's ears droop instantly, clearly indicating that she has accepted her fate.
I'm envious of the good relationship you three have.
After that, Miki Nikaidou takes us to the other food stalls to show us the "delicious snacks" she mentioned. Without exception, all of them are marked as special menu items.
{var:player_nickname}, I want to eat this one!
Are you sure? I don't think I've seen many people buy this snack...
I can't have it?
Yes, yes, yes, of course you can get it. Please stop baring your fangs at me.

After visiting all the stalls, the four of us bring back a pile of things we'll call food for now to an empty table and sit down. Whether we're in for a delicious feast or in deep trouble depends on what this "food" will do to us.
Aren't you going to have any? I won't hold back then. Gulp!
...Does it taste good?
The meat tastes great! It's delicious!
Nyaa... Master, try some. It is really tasty, nyaa!
Really... Oh?! It's delicious! I'm going to have another piece!
Hehe, it sounds like you all like it. Try some of the other snacks too.

Maybe it's because I didn't have any high expectations that I found those chicken nuggets to be quite delicious. After overcoming our first psychological barrier, Ichihime and I both feel more at ease and actively reach out to try the other snacks.
This is the first time I've eaten sweet and sour steamed eggs, nyaa. I thought apple steamed eggs would taste weird, but it's surprisingly delicious, nyaa.
A pizza that has watermelon on it... It's too sweet. I prefer pizzas with meat on them.
This snack is quite good for summer because it's delicious and beautiful.
Master, what's the black stuff in your bowl?
Nyaa... just hearing the name makes me think it tastes bad. It looks strange too, nyaa.
Haha... it's actually not that bad. It tastes a little like a sweet and sour candied fruit, and it isn't bitter at all.
Although the snacks Miki Nikaidou recommended all look a little strange, they are all delicious in their own way. It looks like we've misunderstood her.
I'm full. You can share the three remaining snacks.
This bowl of soup looks really delicious. {var:player_nickname}, I'd like this bowl of soup.
Master, I want these dango, nyaa!
Then I'll have the deep-fried skewers that seem to be made from mysterious ingredients. Umm... Huh?

What is this taste...? Sweet, sour, bitter, spicy, and salty all come to mind, but none of them are able to describe the taste in my mouth. I can't even say if it's good or bad. I can't stop myself from spitting it out of my mouth, but even so, the weird taste still lingers in my mouth.
What's worse is that an accidental burp sends this taste straight up to my nose, making my eyes glaze over and my consciousness blur...
Could I have eaten something that had gone bad...? How is the food you two ate? It shouldn't have gone bad--
Nyaa!!! I-It's so spicy, nyaa! I'm going to die, nyaa! Give me water!!!
The killer... is this shiitake mushroom soup...
What the heck did we just eat...

I snatch the packaging of these three snacks and force myself to concentrate so I can read their names. The dango that has made Ichihime run around everywhere is called "soaring into the heavens," the skewers that turned my brain to mush are called "good dreams," and the poison that "killed" Lin Lang is marked as "miserable mushroom soup" that is "full of shiitake mushroom emotions."
Come on, the stalls in this food court all use authentic ingredients, and the snacks they make have the advertised effects. It would be unreasonable to not give them a five-star review later.
Hmm? Ahaha... {var:player_nickname}, what are you doing?
With trembling hands, I'm using a skewer to mark each unknown substance in this skewer with a cross.
I'm crossing out the trust between people...
Hehe... maybe I can help you, {var:player_nickname}, and spare you all that trouble.
Master... is it really alright to eat the things Miki mentioned, nyaa?
To be safe, you can't go wrong by making sure three times...
{var:player_nickname}, you haven't eaten much. If you don't eat enough, you'll become a lousy weak adult!
M-Master, nothing will happen to us, right, nyaa?
I've heard that the doctors on this island are all very professional. We should be fine... I think...

The first thing to arrive at the table is called Black Meteor, which the stall says is deep-fried chicken nuggets with black truffle. It sounds quite appealing, but the appearance of these dark chicken nuggets that are supposed to look like meteors makes me wonder if there are burnt pieces mixed among them.
This? Oh, this is bitter melon stewed with bayberry.
